posts.title: From 80 Mbps and Random 100 Mbps Links to a Proven 720 Mbps Wi-Fi Path
posts.description: This is Part 1 of a troubleshooting series built from a real incident rather than a clean-room example. This post keeps the chronological investigation: what looked broken, what actually was broken, the tests that misled me, and the measurements that finally narrowed the fault domain. Part 2 will extract the reusable command runbook; Part 3 will preserve the evidence ledger and restart point.
